description: This file contains a static class 'AssetCopyFlows' responsible for orchestrating the 'Copy Asset' workflow in the data asset management system. It defines request and response record types, and provides an asynchronous method to perform asset copying, including logging and handling related database operations.

classes.name: AssetCopyFlows
classes.description: A static class responsible for orchestrating the copying of assets within the system, including request/response structures and the main workflow method.

methods.name: CopyAssetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies an asset and its related records, logging key events and returning the result wrapped in a response object.
